name: Chat reopen
ownerWords: fix plan and duties based on the board skill and pursue completion of plans
goal: A chat the owner archives comes back on his next message. Each day a fresh chat with an ordinary task is archived while idle and gets one follow-up, which it takes once and answers to the end, with chat_board and tell_owner still working, and it shows in the chat list and its Agents card again, with nobody stepping in. On 10-16 chat 01a14210 came back from an archive without chat_board and tell_owner, on 10-17 the first send after a reopen got a 502, and on 10-18 run-2's reopened chat stayed in the archived list.

metrics.label: The follow-up after the archive landed once and got a finished reply (1 yes, 0 no)
The reopened chat kept its chat tools, and chat_board and tell_owner worked (1 yes, 0 no)
The reopened chat left the archived list and its Agents card answered (1 yes, 0 no)

onMiss: Read the precheck's flagged items first. All three at 1 means a check written since the last run passed: end with no message and start no check. A `pending` item means a check is still going: start no second one, set `board.wake(at=<its end>)` and end the turn, then read its verdict on the wake. Otherwise start today's check detached and end the turn: `await bash('cd $HOME/.local/share/sieun-pi-chat/current/components/user-history && nohup node --import tsx scripts/clean-room/clean-room.ts reopen-check --dir $HOME/.prime/agent/clean-room/chat-reopen --cwd $HOME/src/sieun-pi > $HOME/.prime/agent/clean-room/chat-reopen/driver.out 2>&1 &')`, then `board.wake(at=<now + 5 min>)`, since on 10-18 a whole check took 2 to 3 min (runs 20261018-1553 and -1556). On the wake, the last line of driver.out names the verdict file and its evidence folder; while it has none, wake again at the run's end in its run.json `until`. Never message the test chat, rerun its send, tell it it is a test or touch any other chat. Judge on the verdict file, not on the numbers above. Each missed reading follows this brief's missed-metrics lines: the live job on its fix step gets the failing criterion lines and the evidence path by message, and a step with no live job gets the fix job those lines name, which lands a code fix with a test in the chat service or the agent runtime and releases it. An open or void verdict, a failed setup or a cleanup item is a miss of the check itself: fix its cause, never count it as a pass. Nothing goes outside (c37). All met: end with no message.
